title: Larkspur Program Fee Schedule for the Mortgage Loan File
content:
The Larkspur fee schedule sets, for each Mortgage Loan File program, the up-front application fee, the credit report fee charged per borrower, and the lender and settlement-service charges that appear at closing.

## Up-front fees

| Program | Application fee (USD) | Tri-merge credit report fee per borrower pulled (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 300.00 | 92.40 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 92.40 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 | 92.40 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 450.00 | 92.40 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 450.00 | 92.40 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 495.00 | 92.40 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 695.00 | 92.40 |

The application fee is the fee collected after intent to proceed; an application fee of 0.00 means the program charges none.

## Charges at closing

| Program | Origination charge (percent of the base loan amount) | Underwriting fee (USD) | Processing fee (USD) | Flood zone determination fee (USD) | Real estate tax service fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 1095.00 | 495.00 | 12.50 | 85.00 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 1.000% | 0.00 | 0.00 | 12.50 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 795.00 | 0.00 | 12.50 | 85.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 1095.00 | 495.00 | 12.50 | 85.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 1095.00 | 495.00 | 12.50 | 85.00 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 0.000% | 1195.00 | 595.00 | 12.50 | 85.00 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0.500% | 1495.00 | 795.00 | 12.50 | 85.00 |

The origination charge is a flat percentage of the base loan amount and is disclosed in the zero-tolerance bucket; the other closing charges are flat dollar amounts.

## Illustrations (hypothetical files)

- A hypothetical Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed file with a base loan amount of 1000000.00 USD shows an origination charge of 0.500% of that amount, which is 5000.00 USD; the same file under any program whose origination charge is 0.000% shows none.
- A hypothetical joint application with two borrowers pulled is charged the per-borrower credit report fee of 92.40 USD twice, 184.80 USD in all, under every program.
- Under the Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed program the underwriting, processing and tax service fees are 0.00, while the flood zone determination fee of 12.50 USD still applies.
